visitsIntro: Review proposed and confirmed visits, then assign eligible caregivers.
savedRefreshFailed: The server confirmed the change, but the latest view could not be loaded. Refresh before making another change.
advisory: Candidate ranking is advisory. Eligibility, conflicts and travel buffer are rechecked transactionally when assigning.
noEligible: No eligible caregivers. Review excluded reasons and caregiver setup.
noSelection: Select at least one PLANNED visit and a caregiver.
error: This action could not be completed. No success has been assumed.
denied: You cannot access this record or action in the current agency workspace.
stale: This record changed. Refresh before retrying.
validation: Review the required fields, state and date range.
scheduleConflict: Assignment conflicts with another confirmed visit or the travel buffer.
caregiverUnavailable: The caregiver is not eligible for this visit at commit time.
idempotencyConflict: This action key was already used for different data. Refresh and retry.

changes.title: Customer change requests
changes.intro: Customer cancellation and reschedule requests. The original appointment stays unchanged until a request is approved.
changes.empty: No change requests match this filter.
changes.confirmCancel: This cancels the confirmed appointment. The original booking is kept unless the server confirms approval.
changes.confirmReschedule: This moves this occurrence only to the proposed time. Other occurrences remain unchanged.
changes.approveHelp: Approval rechecks the caregiver's eligibility, availability, conflicts and travel buffer; a conflict keeps the request pending.
changes.changePending: This visit already has a pending change request.

review.noNotes: No notes were recorded for this visit.
review.correctionHelp: Corrections are appended with author and reason. The original note is preserved.
